Are you passionate about technology and gadgets? Ready to kickstart your career in a dynamic, high-tech warehouse as Warehouse Worker? At Arrow Electronics, you can earn up to € 19.50 per hour (including shift allowance), enjoy personal coaching, and work toward a permanent contract.  Does this sound good? Then read the vacancy below! 👇

What we offer
- Salary of € 15.00 per hour!
-  30% shift bonus after 20:00 — € 19.50!
- A full-time job!
- Travel allowance & 8% holiday allowance!
- Weekly payment!
- Free on-site gym access! Get fit at work!

Who you are
As an Warehouse Worker at Arrow you're a motivated hands-on star who thrives on speed! You also need to meet the following job requirements:

- You speak Dutch, English, or German.
- You are available full-time from Monday to Friday.
- You are available to work in a 2-shift system (06:00–15:00 and 13:00–22:00).
- You have your own transportation to get to Greenport Venlo.
- You are comfortable working with computers and digital systems.
- You are comfortable standing for the duration of your shift.
- You are looking for long-term employment.

What will you do
At Arrow, you’ll handle all kinds of cool electronic products shipped across Europe. On your first day as Warehouse Worker, you’ll be paired with a buddy to help you settle in, how great is that? You’ll scan, register, and check items to make sure everything’s perfect. When it’s time to recharge, enjoy a fresh meal in our cafeteria or relax on the rooftop terrace! Your tasks will include:

- Unloading trucks and registering goods in the system using computers.
- Picking orders at the pick stations.
- Scanning products and packing them carefully.
- Stacking pallets and loading trucks.
- Working with computers and digital systems to process orders correctly.
- Driving an electric pallet truck.
